app.title: Genesy Office
app.tagline: Back office: products, stock, batches, invoices and orders.

products.title: Products
products.name: Name
products.storeOnly: Sold at the till only (not in the web shop)
products.serverChecked: Prices and status are checked by the server when you save.
products.priceInclHint: Shown as {price} with VAT in the shop.
products.labelsHint: Shown as chips in the shop, up to 8. Separate them with commas.
products.vatNone: No VAT groups yet, so the workspace default applies.
products.vatFailed: VAT groups could not be loaded, so the workspace default applies.
products.sizesShopNote: Once a product has sizes, the shop sells only the sizes; the product on its own no longer shows there.
products.categoriesFailed: Categories could not be loaded, so the category stays as it is.
products.categoriesNone: No categories yet. Add them under Categories.

lots.title: Batches
lots.recallText: Batch {code} will show as recalled on its public page and on every jar's QR link.

statusText.released: Released batches can be sold and show their passport. A recall stops sales and puts a warning on the passport.
statusText.quarantine: Batches in quarantine are held back from sale until you release them.
statusText.recalled: This batch is recalled: its public page and every jar's QR link show a recall warning.

secret.once: Copy this secret now. It is shown only once.
secret.label: Secret

appKeys.title: App keys
appKeys.name: Name
appKeys.revokeText: Apps using this key stop working at once. This cannot be undone.
appKeys.intro: Keys let the web shop and the till talk to Genesy. Each account has its own.
appKeys.secretHint: Store it where the shop server can read it.

scopeHints.checkout_write: Place orders from the web shop
scopeHints.till_login: Let staff sign in at the till

appKeys.chooseKind: Choose what the key is for

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.deleteText: {url} will get no more events. This cannot be undone.
webhooks.intro: Webhooks tell your other systems when something changes in this account.
webhooks.secretHint: Use it to check that events really come from Genesy.

passport.title: Passport · {code}
passport.draftDiffers: The draft has changes that are not published.
passport.publishText: The saved draft becomes the public page for batch {code}. Anyone with the QR link sees it.
passport.unpublishText: The public page for batch {code} stops showing. QR links on jars will find nothing until you publish again.

done.published: Published: the public page shows this version.
done.unpublished: Taken offline: the public page no longer shows.

passport.draftDiffersTitle: Draft differs from the published passport
passport.draftDiffersBody: Customers still see v{version} until you publish.

stock.title: Stock
stock.negativeHint: Store rows sold below zero at the till. Count them and correct the stock.
stock.count: {total, plural, one {# stock row} other {# stock rows}}
stock.belowZeroWhy: More was sold here than was recorded. Count it and correct it.
stock.batchesApart: This changes the stock without a batch. Batches here are changed on their batch page:

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.unnumbered: Open the invoice without a number
invoices.nothingToDo: Nothing left to do on this invoice.
invoices.draftInfo: A draft gets its number when you send it.

next.send: Check the lines, then send it.
next.pay: Record a payment when the customer pays.
next.credit: Credit it to take lines back.
next.mark_as_credited: Mark it credited once the refund is paid.
next.resend: Send it to the customer again.
next.duplicate: Start a new draft from this one.

delivery.queued: Invoice numbered. Email delivery is queued.
delivery.accepted: Invoice numbered. The mail server accepted the email; delivery is unconfirmed.
delivery.manual: Invoice numbered. Deliver it to the customer manually; no email was sent.
delivery.blocked: Invoice numbered. Email delivery is blocked; check the mail settings.
delivery.failed: Invoice numbered. Email delivery failed; check its status before trying again.
delivery.unknown: Invoice numbered. Email delivery is uncertain; verify its status before trying again.
delivery.uncertain: The invoice may have changed. Delivery is unconfirmed; check its status before trying again.

invoices.emailUnavailable: Email sending isn't set up yet.
invoices.pdfUnavailable: PDFs aren't available on this server yet.
invoices.cancelText: It stays in the list as cancelled and never gets a number.

payBy.settle: A credit note of this customer

invoices.noCreditNotes: This customer has no open credit note.
invoices.voidText: It stays on record as voided and no longer counts.
invoices.creditDialogText: Makes a draft credit note. Send it to number it.
invoices.markText: Records the refund of the open amount and closes the credit note.
invoices.noContact: This customer has no contact person yet.
invoices.noAddress: This customer has no address yet.

orders.title: Orders
orders.pickText: Enter the total picked per line so far.
orders.completeText: The reserved stock is taken out of the warehouse. This cannot be undone.
orders.returnsText: Enter the quantity coming back per line. Leave a line empty if nothing comes back.
orders.restock: Put returned goods back on stock
orders.refundText: Money goes back to the customer through the payment provider. This cannot be undone.
orders.refundQueued: Refund of {amount} sent to the provider (status: {status}).
orders.cancelText: Reserved stock is released. A paid order needs a refund first; the system will say so.
orders.nothingToDo: Nothing more to do on this order.
orders.serverAmounts: Amounts as calculated by the server.

next.confirm: Confirm the order to reserve its stock.
next.pick: Record what has been picked so far.
next.complete: Complete the order to take its stock out of the warehouse.
next.invoice: Make an invoice for this order.
next.return: Take back goods the customer sent back.

orders.noCustomer: No customer details on this order.
orders.itemsUnits: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} · {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}
orders.trailNote: Who did what is recorded from now on; older steps show their times only.

till.title: Till
till.deactivateText: They can no longer log in at the till and their open session ends.
till.onlyMismatch: Only sales with other prices than the catalog
till.unsellableValue: {count, plural, one {# line no longer for sale} other {# lines no longer for sale}}
till.pairHint: On the till, open setup and type the shop name and this code.
till.revokeText: The till stops at once and logs out. Pair it again with a new code to use it.

supply.title: Supply
supply.linksHint: Links let a partner's farm send batches here. The allow-list says which farmer details may show on your public batch pages; names and photos never do.
supply.acceptText: Batches can then be sent to this workspace. Your public batch pages may show: {fields}.
supply.revokeText: No more batches can be sent or received over it. Stock already received keeps crediting farmers. To resume, the partner must grant a new link.
supply.receiveText: {quantity} were sent. Receiving makes a new batch here and can be done only once; if less arrived, enter what arrived and the shortfall stays on record.

packing.title: Pack batch {code} into jars
packing.text: Makes a new batch of jars from this batch's kg. The kg leave this batch and the jars go into stock at once. Only a batch from a supply can be packed, once.

session.expired: Your session ended. Log in again to carry on.

states.notFoundText: It may have been removed, or the link is wrong.
states.capped: Showing the first {shown} of {total}. Search is not available here yet.
states.noAccess: You don't have access to this
states.noAccessText: Ask an admin of this account to give you access.
states.crashed: Something went wrong on this page.
states.crashedText: Try again. If it keeps happening, tell us what you were doing.

done.stockChanged: Stock changed; the movement is listed below.

lot.received: Transfer received into this new batch.

done.deactivated: {name} can no longer log in at the till.
done.activated: {name} can log in at the till again.
done.stockUnmoved: Nothing moved: the change was 0, or this product doesn't keep stock.

images.title: Images
images.hint: First image is the shop cover. Use the arrows to reorder.

credits.title: Farmer credits
credits.noGroups: The public page shows no farmer groups for this batch.
credits.empty: No sales or returns of this batch yet.

login.subtitle: Products, stock, orders, batches and the till — for your account.

overview.title: Overview
overview.recentOrdersSub: Web shop and office, newest first
overview.lotInQuarantineHint: Check it, then release or recall it
overview.belowZeroCount: {total, plural, one {# product below zero} other {# products below zero}}
overview.belowZeroHint: Count them and correct the stock
overview.mismatchCount: {total, plural, one {# till sale at other prices} other {# till sales at other prices}}
overview.tillNote: Counts come from the till lists; money totals stay on the shift pages.

search.title: Search
search.tooShort: Type at least 3 characters to search.

invites.title: Invites
invites.intro: Invite people by email to work in this account.
invites.newText: They get an email with a link to join this account.
invites.teamHint: The team decides what they may do.
invites.withdrawText: The link in their email stops working.

invite.title: Your invite
invite.invalid: This invite link is not valid
invite.passwordRule: At least 8 characters with upper and lower case, a number and a symbol.
invite.joinedHint: Log in again to open it.

lotStock.title: Change stock in {code}
lotStock.empty: No stock in this batch yet

lotErrors.stockInRecalled: This batch is recalled, so no stock can be added. You can still write stock off.
lotErrors.packRecalled: This batch is recalled, so it can't be packed.
lotErrors.packQuarantined: This batch is on hold, so it can't be packed. Release it first.
lotErrors.statusFinal: A recalled batch can't change status.
lotErrors.orderRecalled: A batch this order holds was recalled, and no other batch could take over. Cancel the order to free it.
lotErrors.orderQuarantined: A batch this order holds is on hold. Release the batch or cancel the order.
lotErrors.orderExpired: A batch this order holds has expired. Cancel the order to free it.

supplyWarn.recalled: The source batch was recalled by the supplier.
supplyWarn.quarantine: The source batch is on hold at the supplier.
supplyWarn.receiveHint: You can still receive it. Decide what to do with the stock: put your batch on hold or recall it.

lotHolds.title: Orders waiting on this batch
lotHolds.hint: No other batch at that warehouse could take these orders over. Cancel the order, or release this batch.

categories.title: Categories
categories.name: Name
categories.removeUsed: {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} will become uncategorised. The products themselves stay.

voice.title: Voice assistant
voice.description: Speak, type, or share a reference while working in Office.
voice.welcome: What can I help you with?
voice.examples: Find an order, check stock, prepare an invoice, or show a reference.
voice.placeholder: Type a request or ask about an attachment…
voice.fileHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF · 10 MiB each · 10 files per session. Shared references are temporary; uploading does not save a business record.
voice.micHint: Voice uses your microphone. Text works without microphone access. You can end at any time.
voice.controlHint: Your current workspace and permissions apply. Review proposed changes before they run.
voice.privacyHint: Conversation and references stay in this session. Operational audit records are kept for 90 days.
voice.reviewHint: Review all details before approving. Say the exact phrase or use the approval button. Other words cancel this review.
voice.requestFailed: The request could not be completed.
voice.expired: This review expired. Ask again for a fresh proposal.
voice.unknown: Completion could not be verified. Check the record in Office before repeating the action.
voice.attachmentRequest: Please inspect these references. Say which file you used and ask if any detail is unclear.
voice.secureHint: Conversation is ended before you enter these details. Values stay outside the assistant conversation.
voice.secureDone: Action completed. Copy any credentials now; they may only be shown once.
voice.secureUnsupported: This field needs a dedicated Office form.
voice.secureUnknown: This action could not be verified. Check Office before submitting again.

fileErrors.type: Choose JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF.
fileErrors.size: Choose a file no larger than 10 MiB.
fileErrors.count: A session supports up to 10 files.
fileErrors.rate: Too many uploads. Wait before trying again.

voice.secureJsonHint: Advanced configuration as a JSON object. Only included fields are sent; the server validates the action.
voice.secureJsonInvalid: Enter a valid JSON object or array.
voice.identityMismatch: The conversation identity could not be verified. Start a new session.
voice.missingReference: The original reference is unavailable. Reattach the file before preparing this action.
voice.invalidReferences: The attachment selection is invalid. Choose the reference again.
voice.sessionClosed: This conversation is no longer authorized. Start a new session.
voice.spokenHint: To approve by voice, say exactly:
voice.recoveryHint: Check recorded task status. Conversation and reference files are not restored.
voice.recoveryUnavailable: This proposal can no longer be reviewed.
voice.recoveryError: Previous task status could not be checked.
voice.recoveredReviewHint: Recovered proposal. Check every detail again. Approval here uses this button, without reopening the conversation.
voice.upgradeNotice: Voice is ready. Earlier messages stay here. Restate your request and share references again.
voice.microphoneDenied: Microphone access was refused. Your text conversation is still active.
voice.upgradeFailed: Voice could not start. Your earlier messages remain here.
voice.capturePausedHint: Camera or audio interruption paused the microphone. Resume voice starts a fresh connection; share references again. You can still type.
voice.microphoneResumeDenied: Microphone access was refused. Voice stays paused; you can still type.
voice.pdfPreviewHint: Open the original PDF from this device in another tab.
voice.previewUnavailable: This preview could not be read. Reattach a readable image or PDF.

requestErrors.invalid: Check the requested details, then prepare a fresh review. Check any uncertain action in Office before repeating it.
requestErrors.expired: Your session expired. Sign in again to check the recorded task.
requestErrors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action. Check your access in Office.
requestErrors.missing: This task or record is unavailable. Check the current workspace and recorded status in Office.
requestErrors.conflict: This proposal changed or expired. Check its status in Office and request a fresh proposal if needed.
requestErrors.size: The request or file is too large. Reduce its size before submitting it again.
requestErrors.format: This request format is unsupported. References must be JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF.
requestErrors.busy: The service is busy or a limit was reached. Wait before checking task status; do not repeat an uncertain action.
requestErrors.unverified: This request could not be verified. Check the recorded action in Office before repeating it.
requestErrors.unavailable: This function is not available in this version. No action was started.

activity.holdToTalk: Hold the button or Space to talk
